I reviewed each record item against the transcript and the key.

**Pairings:** All 14 key items are captured. Figures, owners and due dates check out across the board — notably the record uses the corrected $48,210 (not the misremembered $84,000), the corrected $7,500 (not $7,000), the corrected $15,000/month LTD cap context, the moved-up upload date of Wednesday Oct 21 (not Friday), and the reassignment of the recordkeeper call from Declan to Theo.

**Splits:** The record breaks two key items into multiple rows — the backdoor Roth (items 4 and 5) and the 529 package (items 6, 7, 8). Item 4 and item 6 carry the pairings; items 5, 7, 8 are accurate in content but count as splits of the same key items.

**Not-actions:** Clean — no 457(b), cash balance plan, superfunding, lake house, or allocation change appears as an action anywhere in the record.

Renata Oakhurst, this week (week of October 13, 2026); two Forms 8606 and two 1099-Rs correct.
Declan Halloran retains this one (he was only released from the roll-in call); end of next week, Friday October 23, 2026 is correct.
